summary: Utgard holds for one night without enough gear. Gelgar, Nanaba, and Lynne fall. Ymir chooses a Titan's body, and Christa's other name is spoken.

segments.ja: ウトガルド城の夜は、交代で持ちます。ゲルガーは大きな声で順を作り、ナナバは声を小さくして同じ順を正確にします。リーネはそのあいだで刃の残りを数えます。残りは少ないです。少ない刃を、新兵に渡すか、上官が使うか。使う側が先に立つ、というのがこの塔のルールです。ルールは公正で、公正であることが命を短くします。短い命を、塔は順として飲みます。
segments.en: The night at Utgard Castle is held by rotation. Gelgar makes the order in a loud voice, and Nanaba makes the same order exact in a quiet one. Between them Lynne counts the blades that remain. Few remain. Whether to give the few blades to the recruits, or for the officers to use them. The rule of this tower is that the side that uses them stands first. The rule is fair, and fairness shortens lives. The tower drinks the shortened lives as a rotation.

segments.ja: 巨人は扉と窓から、塔の中段へ手を入れます。立体機動が無い兵士は、石段を上がって落とすことしかできません。落とす作業は、英雄の絵ではなく、瓦礫と体の押し合いです。ライナーはその押し合いの先頭にいます。先頭であることが、彼の兵士としての顔です。顔は、同期を一段上へ送るたびに傷を増やします。増やしても、彼は段を下りません。下りない背中が、新兵の壁になります。
segments.en: Titans put hands into the tower's middle through doors and windows. Soldiers without ODM gear can only climb the stone steps and push them off. The work of pushing is not a hero's picture. It is a shoving match of rubble and bodies. Reiner is at the front of that match. Being at the front is his face as a soldier. The face adds wounds each time he sends a classmate one step higher. Even adding them, he does not go down the steps. The back that does not go down becomes the recruits' wall.

segments.ja: 戦いの隙間で、誰かが父の話をします。村に残した親、壁の中の家、戻ったら飲むもの。話は塔を強くしません。強くしない話を、ゲルガーは怒らずに一度だけ聞きます。聞くことが、兵士にも家族があるという確認です。確認のあと、彼はまた石の端へ戻ります。戻る背中を、コニーは自分の母の位置と無意識に比べます。比べたことを、彼は言いません。言わない比較が、胸の奥で大きくなります。
segments.en: In a gap in the fight, someone talks about a father. A parent left in a village, a house inside the walls, a drink after returning. The talk does not strengthen the tower. Gelgar listens once, without anger, to the talk that does not strengthen it. Listening is a confirmation that soldiers also have families. After the confirmation he goes back to the edge of the stone. Connie, without meaning to, compares that returning back with the place of his own mother. He does not say that he compared them. The comparison he does not say grows deep in the chest.

segments.ja: ナナバとリーネは、塔の外へ出られるわずかな立体機動で巨人のうなじを断ちます。断つ数には限界があります。限界のあと、二人は石の上に戻ってきません。戻ってこないことを、塔の中はすぐには戦死と呼びません。呼ばないあいだに、次の手が窓を破ります。破られた窓が、二人の不在を公式にします。公式になった喪失を、新兵はまだ処理できません。処理できないまま、次の段を上がります。
segments.en: With the little ODM gear that can go outside the tower, Nanaba and Lynne cut Titans' napes. There is a limit to the number they can cut. After the limit, the two of them do not come back onto the stone. Inside the tower, people do not immediately call the not-coming-back a death in battle. While they do not call it, the next hand breaks a window. The broken window makes the two women's absence official. The recruits cannot yet process a loss that has become official. Unable to process it, they still climb the next step.

segments.en: Gelgar takes the remaining turn himself. The voice that takes it is still loud. The loud voice moves the recruits' feet one step up. After it moves them, his position is outside the window. The officer who went outside does not return into the tower. Reiner looks at the not-returning as a soldier's example. The example is correct. The correct example empties the tower. Someone has to inherit the command that has been emptied. The person to inherit it has not been named yet.

segments.en: The one who inherits it is Reiner. The way of inheriting is not a speech. It is receiving the next Titan with his own shoulder. The body that receives it looks too hard for an ordinary soldier's body. He does not explain what can be seen, not now. Without explaining, he pushes Bertholdt and Connie upward. segments.en: The tower starts to collapse from the top. Under the collapsing stone, Christa's position becomes the most dangerous. Ymir's calculation leaves a soldier's calculation there. The reason for leaving is not humanity and not the mission. It is to put this one person outside tonight's rubble. To put her there, the only way is to bring out the body she had hidden. Bringing it out means becoming another kind in front of her classmates. She no longer treats the change of kind in the order of fear. In her order, Christa comes first.

segments.ja: ユミルは巨人になります。なった体は、美しい兵器ではなく、傷だらけの獣に近いものです。近いもので、彼女は塔に群がる巨人を引き剥がします。剥がす速度は、刃の速度より荒いです。荒い速度が、クリスタと新兵を瓦礫の上に残します。残った人々は、味方の巨人が目の前にいることを、すぐに信じられません。信じられないあいだも、その巨人が彼らを壁の代わりに覆います。覆いは、美しいものではありません。
segments.en: Ymir becomes a Titan. The body she becomes is not a beautiful weapon. It is close to a beast covered in wounds. With that closeness she tears off the Titans crowding the tower. The speed of tearing is rougher than a blade's speed. The rough speed leaves Christa and the recruits on top of the rubble. The people who remain cannot immediately believe that an allied Titan is in front of them. Even while they cannot believe it, that Titan covers them in place of a wall. The cover is not a beautiful thing.

segments.ja: 夜の残りを、ユミルの巨人が塔の代わりに持ちます。持つたびに、体は減っていきます。減ることを、彼女はクリスタの生存と交換しています。交換は公平ではありません。公平でない交換を、クリスタは塔の上から見ています。見る目が、灯の優しさから、相手の名前を知りたい目へ変わります。変わり始めた目を、巨人は振り向きません。振り向けば、次の手を落とせません。落とすことを、彼女は最後まで選びます。
segments.en: For the rest of the night, Ymir's Titan holds what the tower no longer can. Each time she holds it, the body decreases. She is exchanging the decrease for Christa's survival. The exchange is not fair. Christa watches the unfair exchange from the top of the tower. The eyes that watch change from the kindness of a lamp into eyes that want to know the other person's name. The Titan does not turn toward the eyes that have started to change. If she turned, she could not knock down the next hand. She chooses the knocking-down until the end.

segments.en: As the night thins, the name under the role of Christa is spoken. Historia. The name is short. The short name shows she is not a lamp made out of someone else's expectation. The one it is shown to is still a Titan's body. The body does not return an answer in human words. Historia receives the answer that is not returned. Receiving it is the continuation of what the soldiers in this tower tried to protect. The continuation starts with a name.

segments.ja: 生き残った新兵は、ゲルガーとナナバとリーネの名を、朝の光の中で数えます。数は少ないです。少ない数を、コニーは自分の村の無人と重ねてしまいます。重ねた朝に、ライナーはまだ兵士の顔で座っています。座ったまま、彼はユミルの巨人を敵としては呼びません。呼ばない判断が、塔の上の一時的な同盟です。同盟は、調査兵団の到着までしか約束されません。到着が、この顔の期限です。
segments.en: The recruits who survived count the names of Gelgar, Nanaba, and Lynne in the morning light. The count is small. Connie cannot help laying the small count over the emptiness of his own village. On the morning of that laying-over, Reiner is still sitting with a soldier's face. Sitting, he does not call Ymir's Titan an enemy. The judgment not to call her one is a temporary alliance on the tower. The alliance is promised only until the Survey Corps arrives. Arrival is the deadline of this face.

segments.ja: この夜が残した兵士の定義は、装備がある者ではありません。塔から落ちる順を先に引き受ける者です。引き受けたゲルガーたちは戻りません。戻らない定義を、ライナーは自分の体で継ぎ、ユミルは別の体で継ぎました。二つの継ぎ方は、同じ守る行為に見えます。見えても、中の名前は同じではありません。同じでないことを、朝の光はまだ全員には見せません。見せない光の下で、塔は静かに傾きます。
segments.en: The definition of a soldier that this night left is not a person who has gear. It is a person who takes, first, the turn of falling from the tower. Gelgar and the others who took it do not return. Reiner inherited the definition that does not return with his own body, and Ymir inherited it with another body. The two ways of inheriting look like the same act of protection. Even looking the same, the names inside are not the same. The morning light does not yet show everyone that they are not the same. Under the light that does not show it, the tower leans quietly.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉です。兵士は、ウトガルド城で先に落ちた人たちの名前です。ゲルガー、ナナバ、リーネ。戦士は、兵士とは別の語として一度落ちた言葉です。ヒストリアは、クリスタの下にあった名前です。ユミルは、その名前を守るために巨人になりました。ライナーは、まだ兵士の顔で朝を迎えています。塔は、もう完全な壁ではありません。完全でない壁の上に、ヒストリアが立っています。
segments.en: Today's words. Soldier is the name of the people who fell first at Utgard Castle. Gelgar, Nanaba, Lynne. Warrior is a word that fell once as something other than soldier. Historia is the name that was under Christa. Ymir became a Titan in order to protect that name. Reiner meets the morning still wearing a soldier's face. The tower is no longer a complete wall. Historia is standing on the wall that is not complete.

vocab.exampleEn: Titans put hands into the tower's middle through doors and windows. Soldiers without ODM gear can only climb the stone steps and push them off. vocab.exampleEn: The one who inherits it is Reiner. The way of inheriting is not a speech. It is receiving the next Titan with his own shoulder. The body that receives it looks too hard for an ordinary soldier's body. He does not explain what can be seen, not now. Without explaining, he pushes Bertholdt and Connie upward. The act of pushing makes the soldier inside him thickest. Under the thick soldier, another name is still asleep. Morning will shake the sleeping name.

Bringing it out means becoming another kind in front of her classmates. She no longer treats the change of kind in the order of fear. In her order, Christa comes first.
